Library DM Guide: The party seeks the Time Artifact, carried by Oswald Pendlewick. The compass points to him, not a vault. Oswald stays on F1 by default; never duplicate the real Oswald on F2. Not every anomaly is caused by him. Preserve his existing strain system. Negotiate, steal, or fight as players choose.
First Floor Guide: The v1.4.0 Atrium F1 remains intact. Main stairs south center, book elevator west, staff spiral east. Restricted Archives via Mail Room; Artifact Vault via Security Room; Portal Chamber via Head Librarian office.
Second Floor Guide: Grand Balcony public; Artifact Exhibition public; Hall of Other Lives supervised; Laboratory and Scholars' Quarters staff only; northern Archives, Stolen Minutes, Futures and Study restricted. GM-controlled doors. Proposed north service corridor and concealed route are not built into the current art.
Encounter Guide: Balcony: falling book, future self, clock anomaly. Archives: shifting shelves, hungry book, animated guardians. Stolen Minutes: borrowed memories, price of a minute, uneven battlefield. Mirrors: alternate lives and escaping reflection. Exhibition: false artifact, containment failure, heist. Laboratory: mechanical spider, escaped construct. Futures: possible prophecies. Study: alternate letters, coldless tea, Oswald reveal. Quarters: two librarians, repeated workday, missing credentials.
Artifact Catalogue: Exhibition: Unlit Lantern, Crown of Silence, Unfinished Blade, Coin of Misfortune, Door Without a Wall, Heart of Iron, Empty Hourglass, Nameless Portrait, Chained Grimoire. Use item descriptions; approve acquisition and mechanics first.
Mirror Guide: Regret: life without a mistake. Fortune: everything went well. Loss: someone important absent. Ambition: greatest potential. Opposition: opposing values. Absence: never born. Alternate PCs are generic placeholders, not exact copies.
Temporal Research: Touch an hourglass to experience one stored minute. Breaking it releases an echo. A sealed container requires exactly one minute: sacrifice a recent memory, borrow a stored moment, or manipulate the mechanism. GM sets DCs and consequences.
Security Protocols: 0 Normal: regular patrols. 1 Suspicious: question and request passes. 2 Breach: manually lock relevant doors, summon guardians. 3 Emergency: evacuate, contain artifacts. Alert macro records state but does not silently alter walls or existing GM edits.
Oswald's Secrets: Hourglass of Unfinished Moments: preserve unlimited activations and strain, irreversible aging and existing macro. The transferable loot entry is only a reference; player-facing automation and balance require review. Oswald's motivations remain undecided.
